/*selectBuyerMdCmUniformSearchList*/ SELECT S.IMGFILE_NAME, --[01] S.IMGFILE_DIR, --[02] S.DESCRIPTION, --[03] S.SPECIFICATION, --[04] S.ORIGIN_TEXT, --[05] S.MAKER_NAME, --[06] S.UNIT_MEASURE, --[08] S.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, --[11] S.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, --[13] S.HS_NO, --[14] S.TEXT1 AS GRP_CODE --[15] 대표코드 FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM NUM, A.IMGFILE_NAME, A.IMGFILE_DIR, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.MAKER_NAME, A.UNIT_MEASURE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = A.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_TEXT, A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, A.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, A.HS_NO, A.TEXT1 FROM ( SELECT DECODE(TRIM(BYIT.IMGFILE_NAME), NULL, (SELECT IMG_NAME FROM CMSIMGES WHERE IMG_NO=CATLG.IMG_NO),BYIT.IMGFILE_NAME) AS IMGFILE_NAME, DECODE(TRIM(BYIT.IMGFILE_DIR), NULL, (SELECT IMG_DIR FROM CMSIMGES WHERE IMG_NO=CATLG.IMG_NO),BYIT.IMGFILE_DIR) AS IMGFILE_DIR, BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION, BYIT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, BYIT.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, BYIT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, BYIT.ORIGIN_CODE AS ORIGIN_CODE, BYIT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG AS PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, NVL(TRIM(BYIT.OVER_SHORT_FLAG),'N') AS OVER_SHORT_FLAG, TRIM(BYIT.HS_NO) AS HS_NO, COD.TEXT1 AS TEXT1
FROM ICOMBYIT BYIT , CMSCATLG CATLG , ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND COD.TYPE = 'UNIF' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD.CODE2 IN( SELECT MAX(CODE2) FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND TYPE = 'UNIF' AND FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY TEXT1) AND COD.CODE1 = BYIT.BUYER AND COD.CODE2 = BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND BYIT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N','Y') AND BYIT.CMS_CATLG_ID = CATLG.CMS_CATLG_ID(+) AND CATLG.STD_FLAG(+)='Y' AND BYIT.STATUS != 'D'
AND BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_description}||'%'
AND BYIT.MAKER_NAME LIKE '%'||#{st_maker_name}||'%'
ORDER BY BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC )A ) S

/*getUniformSizeSelect*/
SELECT CQDT.AGENT||'@'||COD.CODE2||'@'||CQDT.CONTRACT_NO||'@'||CQDT.CONTRACT_SEQ||'@'||COD.CODE1||'@' ||CQDT.UNIT_PRICE||'@'||(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CQDT.AGENT) ||'@'||BYIT.IMGFILE_DIR||'@'||BYIT.IMGFILE_NAME AS CODE ,CQDT.SPECIFICATION||'('||COD.CODE2||')' AS TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD , ICOMCQDT CQDT, ICOMBYIT BYIT WHERE CQDT.BUYER = BYIT.BUYER AND CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND BYIT.STATUS != 'D' AND CQDT.STATUS != 'D' AND COD.BUYER = #{SEARCH1} -- 파라미터 고객사 코드 AND COD.TEXT1 = #{SEARCH2} -- 파라미터 대표코드 AND COD.TYPE = 'UNIF' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD.CODE1 = CQDT.BUYER AND COD.CODE2 = CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CQDT.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = COD.BUYER
